fields.message: For Rowan Diaz (rowan.diaz@example.test): Please refund the $99.99 CloudBox annual plan charge posted October 1, 2026. I used the trial only to move photos and do not need the annual service. Your September 24 email states a 14-day refund window; today is October 16, so please consider a goodwill exception just outside that window. This is a refund request only; please do not cancel or change the service without separate approval. If a refund requires a service change, please provide the terms for review.

Please consider a goodwill refund of $244.93: seven $34.99 membership charges on April 15, May 15, June 15, July 15, August 15, September 15 and October 15, 2026. I moved across town in April and have not attended since; your September 20 email confirms last check-in April 11. I understand the membership remained active; this is a discretionary unused-membership refund request, not a duplicate-charge dispute. Please advise what refund is available. Do not cancel, freeze or change membership without separate approval.

Rowan Diaz, rowan.diaz@example.test: Your July 10 notice invited long-time members to ask about loyalty pricing. Premium increased from $13.99 to $18.99/month; $18.99 posted August 12, September 12 and October 12, 2026. Please provide a loyalty offer, ideally restoring $13.99, and advise whether a goodwill credit for the $15 total increase is available. Please send all pricing, duration and terms for review. This inquiry does not accept an offer or authorize any plan change or cancellation.
